title: SANTA wire-tier vector
description: A committed conformance vector for the wire tier (santa-wire/v1, byte round-trip). The blessed expected is the entry's own bytes_hex (round-trip to self) UNLESS the entry carries expected_bytes_hex (a non-identity round-trip: JVM-canonical output differs from input). Normative companion to docs/specs/wire-tier.md + docs/specs/wire-roundtrip-nonidentity.md.

kind.description: Serializer selector the runner dispatches on.

source.description: Candidate origin for THIS entry (e.g. fleet:serializer/_test-vectors, ergots:fixture-gen/wire, testnet:capture@<range>). Per-entry so one slice (e.g. Box) can hold vectors vendored from several frameworks. Provenance dir follows: framework source => vendored; testnet:/santa: => authored.

expected_bytes_hex.description: OPTIONAL. The blessed JVM-canonical output when it differs from the input bytes_hex (a non-identity round-trip, e.g. a structural ErgoTree re-serialize that re-encodes a lossy-decoded STypeVar name). Absent => round-trip-to-self (the input IS the expected). See docs/specs/wire-roundtrip-nonidentity.md.

hex.$comment: lower-case hex, whole bytes, non-empty (a wire object is >= 1 byte).
